mapper.select: SELECT id FROM hr_lifecycle_application WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{identifier} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT file_id, file_name, file_size, file_hash FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND file_type = 'HR_EXIT_INTERVIEW' AND biz_type = 'HR_EXIT_INTERVIEW' AND biz_id = #{interviewId} AND deleted = 0 AND url = '' FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(nick_name, ''), user_name) AS label FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id IN #{identifier} ORDER BY nick_name, user_id

SELECT file_id AS value, file_name AS label FROM sys_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND file_type = 'HR_EXIT_INTERVIEW' AND biz_type = 'HR_EXIT_INTERVIEW' AND biz_id = #{interviewId} AND deleted = 0 AND url = '' ORDER BY file_id
